# northflank_secret_group (Data Source)

Reads an existing Northflank project secret group. Useful for consuming secrets managed outside of this Terraform configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "northflank_secret_group" "shared" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  id         = "shared-secrets"
}

output "db_host" {
  value     = data.northflank_secret_group.shared.variables["DB_HOST"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the secret group (the derived slug of its name).
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project that the secret group belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the secret group.
- `docker_secret_mounts` (Attributes Map, Sensitive) Decrypted Docker secret mount contents. Keys are mount identifiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_secret_mounts))
- `files` (Attributes Map, Sensitive) Decrypted secret files. Keys are absolute file paths. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `name` (String) Name of the secret group.
- `priority` (Number) Merge priority (0–100).
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Access restriction settings for this secret group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `secret_type` (String) Injection scope. One of: `environment` (Runtime), `arguments` (Build), or `environment-arguments` (Build and Runtime).
- `stage_id` (String) Environment (stage) this secret group is associated with, if set.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the secret group.
- `type` (String) Hierarchy type: `secret` or `config`.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Decrypted environment variable key/value pairs.

<a id="nestedatt--docker_secret_mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_secret_mounts`

Read-Only:

- `data` (String) Mount contents, base64-encoded.
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the mount contents (e.g. `utf-8`).


<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `data` (String) File contents, base64-encoded.
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the file contents (e.g. `utf-8`).


<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Read-Only:

- `jobs` (Set of String) IDs of jobs that may access this secret group.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether access is restricted to specific resources.
- `services` (Set of String) IDs of services that may access this secret group.
- `tag_match_condition` (String) Whether all tags must match (`and`) or any tag is sufficient (`or`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags that resources must bear to access this secret group.
